added.title: The Man in the Wall
added.prompt:
A monumental, identity-locked photorealistic sculpture installation.

SUBJECT: A colossal, hyper-realistic portrait sculpture of the specific man from the reference photo (image_0.png). The identity is paramount, featuring his exact facial structure, nose shape, high cheekbones, strong jawline, and preserved detailed skin texture, maintaining his youth.

EXPRESSION: His face has a distinct, subtle, and controlled smirk—a knowing, closed-mouth expression that is mischievous and slightly sinister, but is a direct extension of his original jaw and mouth structure, not a distorted broad grin. His direct, intense brown eyes are perfectly rendered, staring forward.

SCENE: The monumental face is bursting out from a jagged, massive hole in the side of a brutalist high-rise concrete apartment building. Broken rebar and concrete chunks frame the emergence.

ENVIRONMENT: The surrounding building facade is visible, with multiple windows, balconies, external air conditioning units, exposed pipes, and ventilation vents. People are seen on a distant street below, looking up, emphasizing the immense scale.

STYLE: Cinematic, highly detailed photography. Harsh, directional sunlight casts deep shadows, emphasizing the realism of the face and the raw, broken textures of the concrete and rebar. A true-to-life integration.

added.title: Queen card
added.prompt:
CREATE a 64 K DSLR ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of the character (female, keeping the same face from the reference image), emerging dramatically from a large cracked playing card of the Queen of Spades.

The Queen figure has elegant, refined facial features and regal hair, wearing an ornate, high-arched crown with intricate gold filigree and embedded red gems.

The character is dressed in luxurious royal gowns with rich gold-and-crimson embroidery, featuring a high stiff collar and heavy regal velvet folds draped across the shoulders.

One arm extends forward in a commanding, cinematic gesture, while the other rests naturally, revealing a subtle tattoo on the hand. The cracked playing card looks like aged stone, with dust and debris breaking loose as the figure pushes through its surface.

Lighting is dramatic and low-key, emphasizing depth, shadows, and highlights across the crown and the textures of the silk and velvet.

Background: dark gradient tone with faint atmospheric particles for a post-apocalyptic mood.

Render in Octane Render / Unreal Engine 5 style with photoreal materials, sharp optics, HDR global illumination, and cinematic depth of field. The overall image evokes grandeur, authority, and quiet power, blending realism with subtle fantasy energy.

orig_55.title: Blue studio fashion portrait blending elegance and androgyny
orig_55.prompt: CREATE a photorealistic 8K full-body portrait inspired by both attached reference images. Use the facial structure, natural beauty, and hairstyle inspired by the portrait reference - smooth skin, expressive eyes, balanced features, and refined bone structure with realistic lighting and natural tones. Place the character in the same studio setting and pose as the blue-themed reference: seated casually on a modern designer lounge chair, leaning back with legs crossed and smiling subtly with relaxed confidence. Outfit: a bold blue unisex tracksuit with matching joggers, white socks, and chunky beige sneakers - a fashion-editorial look that works equally for masculine or feminine forms. Scene: seamless blue studio with a large light-blue abstract Brill shape in the background for a clean, magazine-style composition. Lighting: soft, even, and cinematic, highlighting contours while maintaining rich fabric texture and smooth shadows. Color palette: deep and light blues accented with subtle yellows. Aesthetic: modern, minimal, high-fashion editorial - sharp focus, smooth gradients, realistic fabric detail, and androgynous appeal preserving natural harmony and elegance.
